capabilities: receive notes from ChatGPT or MCP clients into allowed folders
queue notes through a relay with verified delivery receipts
apply version-checked edits, trash moves and file attachments in GitHub mode
pair devices over OAuth and store credentials in SecretStorage
run test notes and diagnostics to verify the receive pipeline
disambiguation: Not a ChatGPT chat client inside Obsidian; it only receives externally created notes, edits, trash moves and attachments into the vault.
extras: Setup interface uses Spanish labels. No public relay is included; Relay mode requires hosting the bundled server yourself or trusting an operator. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and 0.4.4 is an unpublished reliability candidate.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for an external AI client like ChatGPT to create notes in the vault with verified delivery and folder-scoped permissions.

relations.evidence: Create Markdown notes in your current Obsidian vault from ChatGPT or another compatible MCP client.
Advanced GitHub mode reads request JSON files using GET requests to the repository you configure.

requires.name: ChatGPT account with custom MCP write tools
relay hosting and database may cost money

summary: Receives notes created by ChatGPT or other MCP clients into the vault, via Lite links, a hosted relay, or a GitHub request queue.
